results.1c3gl0q: A basket of reeds has tipped over. Small footprints lead away toward the pond.
results.1h1sqe8: The Dry Sea. Walk where the boats used to. Mast to the west.
results.0aueqbd: An empty crate marked with the stamp "MAST." The word "sorry" has been chalked onto its side.
results.0wc5d97: Nestled in the upper corner, half-buried, is a jar containing a cowrie shell.
results.1o2wont: The salt marsh. Spire, north. Stay on the boardwalks.
results.0byg9ab: Tucked among the reeds in the corner is a block of marsh salt, still dry.
results.148z42j: The understory. Bole, north. Roots block the road, so lift your feet high.
results.1ywit7m: Two names are carved into the bark alongside a heart. A third name has been scratched out.
results.16ut3fe: Someone's lunch tin rests beneath the roots. The food is long gone, but the coins remain.
results.1w403ba: The machine fields. Do not disturb the machines. They are on duty.
results.0dzpdhk: A note tied to the cart reads: "Back soon. Don't take the wheel." The wheel is missing.
results.0nzvrrj: Behind the final machine lies a tin of spare parts, wrapped in oilcloth.
results.1urit7o: The tundra. Tusk, north. The ledges are one-way only, much like the weather.
results.15n05tz: A red mitten lies in the snow, frozen mid-wave.
results.1hnwwdq: Hidden beneath a snowdrift in the corner is a flask of smelling salts, sealed tight with a cork.
results.0p6832n: The Hilt road. Hilt is east. Tusk is west. The Hermitage is there, if you insist.
results.0htzpud: Pilgrims' bags sit on a cart with a broken wheel. A sign reads: "Gone to Hilt for a wheel.
results.19n7lo5: Polished to a shine, a guard's lost button lies under the rubble in the corner.
results.11cly7l: The crater fields slope south. Everything here rolls that way.
results.10ec03c: A tipped-over basket, with a trail of apples rolling away toward Fall.
results.0ttqv36: In the far corner, a thumb-sized shard of star glass.
results.0bkq6mx: It descends the hills in fits and starts, never all the way down. One cowrie and a bandage. The bandage is for you.
results.1azs4yg: Once under a statue, which got up and walked away. It keeps the space above clear, just in case. Four cowries, statue not included.
results.186fw56: A sea cave's old shell, still wet inside, breathing with the tide. Things go in and come out fine. My glove hasn't. Three cowries, glove included.
results.0uqe1su: A cast of a standing stone. It stands. It stood before the Seals went in. Five cowries, and I wouldn't ask it to sit.
results.0731a03: A hole left by a shell. It takes stone from what it hits and keeps it. Three cowries. Count your walls afterward.
results.07aktxx: Taken from a church gutter. The same face has been there for six hundred years. It's staring at you now. Two cowries, face included.
results.0kfeqck: A hilltop that stood up and walked off. The hill remained, a bit lower and a bit annoyed. Four cowries for the top.
results.1p6iy5l: Turnstone's well, out for a stroll. Easily frightened. Price: one village. The village would like it back.
results.0rutzkj: From the bottom of a bay. You can't see it from shore. You'll find out. Three cowries, paid in wet socks.
results.1bwppkw: And a fog rising from the low places, hiding what lies within. Two cowries, if you can find it. I can't.
results.0h0o8l2: Coming down from the north on its own. It cracks when it's warm. Three cowries, cash, before it warms up.
results.1l0cc5q: From a rain that came sideways. Still does. It hits twice. Two cowries, which is one cowrie per hit.
results.0z59kt1: Off-path by the shore, a stone or shell marks each visitor. Hit it to grow it faster. Add two cowries and your stone.
results.0sgnl5r: The tide that fights upstream, speeding up with every surge. You catch it on the ebb for three cowries.
results.11ib0tu: Plus the crust of a salt pan, found on foot. It parches whatever it touches, even open wounds. Two thirsty cowries.
results.1u7rv5n: From a river bend. It pivots in place and forces you to pivot too. Three cowries. I grew dizzy just tallying them.
results.1w0ksgp: A hedge. It sprouted across my path while I was staring at it. Two cowries for the hedge. The road is not for sale.
results.1olj9v5: The white underside of a forest. It spreads. It feeds. It has taken some of my change. Three cowries, minus the change.
results.0ixtiqt: From a passing sleeve. It clings to the next thing that drifts by. That is its only desire. One cowrie. It's on my hat.
results.0lupuzz: The husk of an old orchard, shedding fruit. Actual fruit. I have eaten some. I make no demands. Four cowries, plus the cost of asking.
results.0f9b1qx: What remained after the tree was felled. It grows a ring each year regardless. Two cowries now. One more cowrie per ring.
results.1d0zquh: From a field's edge. It bursts when stepped on. Spores settle everywhere, even in my tea. One cowrie, tea extra.
results.1fhl1hd: From a briar near the mill. It snags, holds, and draws blood slowly. The mill workers despise it. Two cowries or eleven thorns.
results.07fnot4: It comes in a cup. Do not drink from the cup. Four cowries, cup included, and I mean it seriously about the cup.
results.18fsjth: The Riders' conception of the heavens. It circles. It makes your world spin faster. Six cowries, which is cheap for a sky.
results.0h1wtln: From a dock. It lifts what lies beneath and places it where it pleases. It put my cart on the roof. Four cowries, cart stays.
results.06lnq4p: This one faces the wind and creates breezes for its companions. Hold your three cowries tight when you pay.
results.1ovbgxs: Fell from the sky one winter. It watches from the spot where it landed. It will watch you count out six cowries, so count correctly.
results.0mav0no: From the old works, with something alive inside the firebox. It stays warm for a hundred years. Three cowries, or two and your blanket.
results.0xsyk2m: In and out, faster every time. Three cowries. Don't block the exit.
results.06cm3qj: Sourced from the old pump. It hums when you turn it. Two cowries and a sandwich, the standard price for sandwiches.
results.0pu3l4p: Like a wolf casting, nose to the ground, chasing a scent from years ago. It sniffs the four cowries before you can offer them.
results.1lc42p7: From an ox team. It drags whatever it's tied to. It won't stop even if you untie it. Three cowries, plus one fence.
results.192zum5: A stoat in its winter fur. It slips through gaps a horn can't. Three cowries, if you can locate the hole it's hiding in.
results.10d6z4w: With a leech attached. It clings until it's full, then keeps clinging. It costs two cowries to get it started.
results.1qlvt2q: From the fence by the mill. It sits and waits. It has outlasted better company than yours. Three cowries. It will wait for those, too.
results.1adpfd8: A bull's cast. It lowers its head first, leaving you about a second to react. Four cowries, paid within that second.
results.0ncjco0: A giant's thumb, detached. The rest of the giant either didn't shed or lost it elsewhere. Five cowries per thumb.
results.1dpae4r: From a spring field. It boxes in spring. It boxes in autumn. It boxed me in summer, out of turn. Two cowries to whoever can contain it.
results.0uom10d: The moon leaves a thin shell behind each month, and they fall in the fields. One cowrie. Thirteen a year.
results.0uous9o: The head of a comet. It appears once in a lifetime, and here it is in my shop. Six cowries, for a once-in-a-lifetime event.
results.16phq3m: Plus a shell from a sky full of green light. It hangs over the north. Five cowries. It doesn't draw.
results.09g16go: Glass from the beach where lightning struck. Lightning strikes the same place twice. Four cowries. Twice.
results.0gyldfh: From a saint still out walking, bareheaded. It floats over someone. Seven cowries, plus a hat for the saint.
results.0lr7tb7: The marsh-mouth buoy register is active. It signals trouble, which is constant. Three cowries. It's ringing now.
results.1fb65y6: The eclipse's shadow, fallen. It sweeps over at noon. Five cowries. Bring a lamp to count them by.
results.1v9yvia: And the shell of a red star, hanging in the sky before trouble arrives. No one agrees on what trouble. Four cowries. I say rain.
results.0coi752: Shed from the sun. It rises all at once. Six cowries and a bucket. A full bucket.
results.1jtj02v: The tack's cast. Not for sale. Tack would want to know who's asking, and how many times.
results.0xyoczr: The moon's first cast. No price. I wouldn't sell it to myself, despite having offered.
results.027rjn4: The old Volute's heart. No price. I don't have a slate big enough, and your grandmother's slate is very big.
results.08d8ktg: The Holdfast's cast. No price. It was never for sale. Nor did it ever call for anything.
results.0x4fv7y: From a turtle, an island. No price. I'd need a slate that floats.
results.09ealty: Plus a dandelion gone to seed. It plants seeds in whoever it argues with. Two cowries. It's arguing with me now.
results.1v27tpr: From a farrier's kit. Six blades, no handle. It leaves one in you. Three cowries for however many it has left.
results.0dj58ru: Plus a curing vat that walked off half full. What's inside is still curing. Three cowries for the vat. I wouldn't price what's inside.
results.04vw1lz: From a hay cart. It starts slow and doesn't stop. It went through the grotto wall once. Four cowries, plus the wall.
results.0sx4o7e: A mole's shell, pink star on the nose. It comes up under you and goes back down. Two cowries, paid underground.
results.1er8s8a: From a root cellar in Turnstone. Hit it when it's nearly empty and it fills back up. Four cowries. The jam's gone.
results.0ds63es: A hobnailed boot that nobody wears. It keeps every nail it drives into you. Three cowries. Left foot only.
results.0x9h6oa: A beach pea pod, sized like a cat. The peas stare back. It sprouts more pods and kicks them away. Two cowries per pod.
results.1oebsfc: A cellar door with an eye where the handle should be. What it traps inside eventually returns. Five cowries. Knock first.
results.0rkotvz: A cave cricket with its knees bent backward. It chirps three times, softly. Three cowries, one per chirp.
results.1a8z4nw: A giant's knucklebone from the Knucklebones. It's hollow, with a mouth over its eyes. Throw it, and it lands twice. Two cowries.
results.189ghkn: A giant's back tooth, hollow as a whelk shell. It peers out from its roots. It grows on whatever it chews. Four cowries. Do not bite.
results.10iai4o: The top bone of a giant's neck. It held a head upright for three hundred years. Now it holds a grudge. It demands four cowries as well.
results.1u2891i: A giant's fingernail. It scratches the same spot until the skin gives way. Three cowries. Unfiled.
results.0aq6f96: The ball and socket of a giant's hip. The head never sits level. It leans heavily to one side or the other. Three cowries. Mine leans left.
results.1v35szt: A wishbone from a bird larger than a barn. It pulls long, then short, then long again. Five cowries. I wished for six.
results.04knk2e: An urchin's test from the dry sea floor, with its mouth underneath. Whatever sticks to it falls off. Two cowries. Unsticky.
results.1g1qeap: A fiddler crab with one claw larger than the rest. Strike the claw, and it strikes back. Three cowries. The claw is extra.
results.1yzuzov: The water hovering over the dry sea, standing on its own reflection. Stones pass right through it. Four cowries. See-through.
results.03rqsti: An anchor from the Wrecks, walking on its flukes. It marks a spot and returns you to it. You will come back. Bring five cowries.
results.1od3ccn: A figurehead that left before the ship sank. It still stands in front of people. Pass the five cowries around it.
results.1tbdk2r: A bilge pump with no ship left to bail. It pumps your tide out instead. Three cowries. The bilge boy wants it back.
results.0v0n1c9: A bloom of jellyfish off the shoreline. It stings anything nearby and burns through your tide to do it. Three cowries. Ouch.
results.1gbbz08: A fragment of the sea's own shell, found by the wall at dusk. The sea demands its return. Seven cowries. The sea hasn't made an offer yet.
results.1ap4x69: Plus a glass eel. You can see its recent meal. Every third bite refuses to let go. Two cowries, plus the cost of whatever it consumed.
results.0mybaza: A slice of peat from the marsh, facing upward from its top. It retains whatever falls inside. Three cowries per brick. I lost a spoon.
results.0li4vfv: A shattered window from beneath the Spire, with an eye in each pane. Each pane absorbs one impact. Five cowries, charged per pane.
results.088hqon: A pew from beneath the Spire, with a face in the backrest. While it is occupied, no one nearby falls completely. Four cowries, seated.
results.10boyvl: Torn sail, mast in face. Tacks in no wind. Two cowries. I've tried blowing.
results.10wd582: Still after forty years, keel off dry land. Moves others far. Five cowries, no delivery.
results.1c54e3l: Ship's cannon talks through its head. Shot lands where you are. Four cowries, plus ducking.
results.0kqj163: Wave breaks off gray wall, one eye in curl. Drags till hit. Four cowries, wet.
results.1beroqt: Skua with second beak in belly. Follows yours, paid when it drops. Three cowries. Same trade.
results.1ob4dji: Driftwood off gray wall, face on cut end. Grows bark on friends. Two cowries, salted. Unsalted costs more.
results.0rci6l6: Sea foam released by gray wall. Hits what it holds. Foam pays bill. Bill comes. Four cowries, I respect it.
results.0hxn114: Heron on one leg, aiming. Longer it stands, worse for you. Three cowries. Aimed at me all week.
results.00vnmgq: Tenor bell under Spire, hopping on clapper. Rings, front stays put. Six cowries. Goes last.
results.1k8xnpd: Sings from middle, an organ pipe. Notes hit people after it stops. Four cowries, plus earplugs.
results.183jbnt: A reliquary with one eye watching through the glass. It takes a piece of whatever you set down. Six cowries. It took my change.
results.04ln66c: A stag's shell, antlers attached. It collects everything you strike it with. Five cowries. It's collecting them, too.
results.1aupc2t: A straw beehive abandoned by its bees. It stings on its own, through the opening in its belly. Two cowries and gloves. My gloves.
results.04sexw6: A taproot from the Bole, walking on its leaves. It anchors things in place and drinks from them. Three cowries and a drink.
results.1niu2a8: A bark beetle bored all the way through. It waits in its own holes and strikes when you leave. Two cowries. The holes are free.
results.0z539ry: Plus the clump of earth from beneath the Bole's roots. A small lump trails behind it. One cowrie. The lump is free. It insists on following.
results.1174yzr: A sapling from the Rootfall, face hidden in the leaves. It holds onto anything that harms its friends. Three cowries. Befriend it.
results.02541e9: Rain that fell upward near the Bole and kept doing so. It makes friends taller and enemies shorter. Three cowries. Ask the Upright Man.
results.14jy60d: A brick kiln from the old works. One side remains warm. Give it a thought, and it returns it harsher. Four cowries, warm side up.
results.042kpel: It carries whatever stands on it to the same place, at the same speed. A conveyor belt's shell. Three cowries, same price.
results.0u2hw56: A sail with nothing left to push it. It comes down beside things about to tip over. Five cowries. I'm standing well back.
results.113i66y: Heated from high above, shut tight like a clam. It opens for a friend and closes behind them. Four cowries. I'm not its friend.
results.0cpnwhh: Spire's censer smokes at the ears. Smoke hits you two breaths later. Pay five cowries between breaths.
results.1v6n9h3: An owl with extra eyes on its wings. It silences all it sees. I'd quote a price, but it's watching. Four cowries.
results.0s9tm52: A face from Bole's roots, one eye too big. Gaze at it to sleep. Wakers fall asleep too. Six cowries if you're awake.
results.1guseld: From the Rim's old mast, a monk-like vigil. It hums unknown signals, passing them on. Four cowries for quiet.
results.1k6x444: From the Dropfield. It points its face at whoever spoke last and repeats it louder. Five cowries. FIVE COWRIES.
results.16xu0ba: Hull scrap fused into a single lump, one eye larger than the other. It runs hot and needs to sit down. Three cowries. I know the feeling.
results.1jmlrc5: Plus a block that walked off the glacier. Stand still near it and your boots freeze to the ground. Pay the four cowries while you're moving.
results.102okwa: What a seal-woman left on the ice. Someone hid it in a chest once. It sleeps wherever it likes now. Five cowries. Don't tell her husband.
results.1yp42wt: Tusks growing upward instead of downward. Every third punch it throws is the one people talk about. Three cowries. People talk.
results.0ybr6hu: From the shelf. Most of it is under the ice, face included. Five cowries for the top. The rest costs extra.
results.167r280: Which waits beneath the shelf, lining its tusk up at you. The longer it waits, the worse it gets. Four cowries, before it lines up.
results.1ko0axr: From the last pair of great auks, gone in my grandfather's time. Their shells kept going. Six cowries, and I'd rather you kept it.
results.13zkspl: And a battle banner, with the pole as a backbone. It snaps once before it does anything. Hand it three cowries and it snaps at those too.
results.1gh72wb: The half of a sword that stays in the grip. It spins when it's cornered. Five cowries for half a sword. The other half is more expensive.
results.10dqiwf: A round shield, with one eye where the boss should be. It counts the blows it takes and pays each one back. Four cowries. Honest, that.
results.1xaoz48: Plus a war horse with the barding still on. Throw it and it gets up and climbs back onto itself. Five cowries and a brush.
results.1e1cwdf: The piece that detaches first. Now it leaves things intentionally. Keep it off the roof. Three cowries. You cover the roof.
results.00fi6jo: A musk ox's shed antler, standing in snow. Eyes near its knees. Frost coats what it faces. I ask four cowries from behind.
results.0zfd9ba: An icicle fell from the eaves, in love with the resident, and gained life for them. Three cowries. It still melts slightly.
results.1jt1shf: A soldier's breastplate from the Hilt road. A face where the heart was. Each dent hardens it and makes it dearer. Four cowries.
results.19ah01i: A battlefield helmet on two short legs. Some days, a drake hides inside. Five cowries, though the price rises on drake days.
results.0iotyc1: An arrow that never fell. It rests in the quiver and emerges sharper. Four cowries. Someone is still waiting beneath it.
results.1j9rcc7: A mudskipper that hops whenever you look at it. Something larger follows it through the mud. Three cowries, and I won't ask what it is.
results.0wyn1nf: A frog with its mouth on its belly. It temporarily turns other creatures into frogs. Three cowries. I was a frog on Tuesday.
results.06jeqkp: A fragment of the moon's shell, broken during its ascent. It throws its edges about, and they return. Six cowries. Mine did not.
results.0hcmoup: An iron stone from a fallen star. If you walk past it, your buckles attempt to stay put. Five cowries, plus whatever buckles it retains.
results.19vujuo: Furnace slag with a brew fermenting inside. Sell it before the brew spoils. Four cowries. I am selling it on.
results.0g6f5dc: The tail end of a scorpion. It walks on its sting, keeping the rest of its body aloft. Five cowries. Do not shake it.
results.1jmtx1a: A jumping cactus. It does indeed jump. Pull out one joint, and another is already in place. Four cowries, which it jumped at.
results.1qv1cgb: A dune containing a dead reef. It rises on the road at night and halts at the door. It buds smaller versions. Four cowries, and two shovels.
results.1ip1ib0: A wobble of hot glass, left behind. It keeps three weathers in its mouth and mixes them. Six cowries. Mixing is free.
results.1cys8z3: A desert skull, bleached white as nacre. It rises once more than you might expect. Five cowries. Then once more.
results.042noqv: A head-catapult throws caught items, growing larger. Costs five cowries. Stand behind it to pay.
results.1v80h5t: A moonlit lakebed reflection. It mimics your next move. Costs six cowries. You were about to pay.
results.1p3ns1t: Moonwater silt eyes at the bottom. Wade to your ankles and stop. I ask three cowries from dry land.
results.13g607m: Broken glass desert debris. It holds its grip until you both cease. Five cowries, paid in gloves.
results.0xyjmfa: A grafted branch, inheriting traits from whichever tree it strikes first. Six cowries. Grafton would charge seven.
results.1bdvo7j: A rung from a ladder on the Climb. With every turn it takes, it climbs higher. Six cowries for the bottom step.
results.0e88asa: A blank space at the edge where nothing existed. Strike it, and everyone present feels the impact. Seven cowries for nothing. A bargain.
results.06l4yd2: The end of a road. Anything that reaches it stays put. It charges the barrier. Seven cowries, and that is the final cost.
results.0zz8lu7: This horizon, which still has its stars revolving around it. They fall when it commands. Seven cowries. It never asks me.
results.12eks6i: A piece of the Rim that walked away. It pulls things over the edge and grows heavier. Seven cowries, charged by weight. Today's weight.
results.1dhs2mg: From the Shallows, a wrinkle in the loose ground. Step on one corner, and the others rise. Six cowries. I would iron it out.
results.17q56lx: A dip in the Shallows that fills with saltwater rising from below. It lays down mud in layers and wears them away. Six cowries, muddy.
results.0w7zbch: A fracture that rose from the ground and walked away. It sets a ring of thorns on anyone who follows. Seven cowries. Walk beside it.
results.0d3j3nr: At the orchard, shears snip one branch for six cowries. Precise work.
results.0wgss5m: A glove's palm faces out. It lunges at friends, knocking them back. Five cowries. No pairs.
results.0358jer: A flat pear tree on the wall feeds leaners. Six cowries, pears included.
results.17r24en: At the foggy edge, the mist bites those who haven't touched it. Seven cowries. Touch first.
results.0cloreo: Beyond the edge lies a drowning thing. Seven cowries for this entry. Rest available.
results.1ybzj6m: Off the Volute's outer curve, a barnacle. It lived its entire life on your world, never once glancing inward. Two cowries.
results.1speds0: It was the lip of the Volute, until one spring the shell outgrew it. So it packed up and left. Three cowries. It still believes it's a lip.
results.0bo49a0: Spray, dried onto the Volute's exterior, square in every grain. I counted them all. Two cowries, plus a week's wage for the counting.
results.1jfl9pu: A sand hopper, dog-sized. It jumps at shadows and lands on them, so keep yours perfectly still. One cowrie. My shadow is still bruised.
results.1269tp1: A fallen star, a grain the size of a fist. Warm on one side, and that side keeps rotating. Four cowries. Bring tongs.
results.14ufc8d: Plus a bottle. It broke on the wrack, got frosted by salt, then walked away. Two cowries. The sharp end is the front, so hold the back.
results.0tk1whc: Fish, dried and salted on the wrack line by no one. Who salts a fish for no one? Very dry. One cowrie, which is more than no one charged.
results.0fnvlpc: One of the five doves from a sand dollar. It flies only at night and brings things back. Four cowries, or whatever it brought you.
results.1go2k1j: And the curl of sand a worm pushes up at low tide. The worm is gone. The curl keeps curling. One cowrie. The worm is extra, if found.
results.08zasg1: Razor clam. It digs straight down whenever a star lands nearby, which is every night here. Three cowries, if you can dig it up.
results.095ht0p: The ring of light a landed star leaves on wet sand! This one has never faded. Five cowries. You won't sleep with it in the room.
results.07mjv5h: Gull. Forty years it rode the Volute's air each dusk. Still rises at six, even indoors. Two cowries. Ceiling extra.
results.0pmaup8: Wrack weed off the tide line. Kids buy it for the pop. One cowrie. Won't pop for the shed.
results.1gwipfi: A crate floated in, shut tight. I offered well for its contents, but it refused to open. Rude. Three cowries, contents unknown.
results.13ewgsx: Tide-pool flower. Closes at any shadow, which is always. Closed now. Two cowries, sold shut.
results.0wsr5cn: Sand hollow where a taken shell lay. It searches for it, hasn't found it. Three cowries. It checks pockets.
results.04b1eis: A dark smudge on the Cowrie's dome. It shifts when you aren't watching. I've never caught it moving, so I trust it. Three cowries.
results.11600uh: The soft sheath a cowrie slides over its shell. It polishes whatever surface it rests on. Three slippery cowries.
results.1lee2sn: Sea spray blown from a wave. The wave has stopped, but the spray hasn't. Two cowries, paid in haste.
results.0n358mk: The top layer of the Cowrie's polish, peeled off in one sheet and left standing. Three cowries. It reveals every fingerprint.
results.1i7t85b: The grit the Cowrie folk use for polishing. It scrubs anything that touches it, including hands. Two cowries. Pay with your other hand.
results.02omz0z: The gap between two of the Cowrie's teeth. It wandered off, and the teeth snapped shut behind it. Four cowries, which is a lot for a gap.
results.1fcac5z: Plus the rolled edge of the Cowrie's lip. It keeps rolling inward. It comes out fast. Two cowries, faster than you.
results.0u293hf: A reflection. It fell three steps behind its owner and never caught up. It mimics your movements. Four cowries, paid three steps ago.
results.1sp1hr2: The back of a mirror, the silver backing. It shows nothing on its own. Hold it up to me, and it reveals three cowries.
results.1xaadgz: Glow from the Cowrie's dome in total darkness. It wandered off on its own one night. Four cowries. It outshines your lamp out of spite.
results.0gbzs5d: Plus wind. It spun inside the Auger so long it took on its shape. Sit down before you count out three cowries.
results.07fl0il: Wave. Gray, standing on sand since my grandfather. Won't budge. Four cowries.
results.0ko2cnr: Cowrie purse that shut up. Clinks when happy. Counting money hurts. Five cowries, or one.
results.0guhbj3: Glazed flower from a Cowrie box. Rings when touched. Ting! That's me. Three cowries/flower.
results.0gfil0m: Three Cowrie teeth meshing on air. They'll mesh on you. Roll up sleeves. Hand me two cowries.
results.1g2lvut: Pig! Small, round, glazed, kept by the Cowrie folk. Rolls when the floor tilts, which it does. Two cowries. You chase it.
results.0cbkuq2: Lichen, found on the Auger's exterior. It migrates to the dry side with every tide. Is it slow? Extremely. One cowrie, payable next year.
results.10cl4la: White dust, once kept in a climber's pouch until it escaped. Two cowries, and it will escape from yours as well.
results.1c9ee4v: The white line the tide leaves on the Auger's walls, rising slightly with each wave. Three cowries and climbing.
results.0asmhbe: Weed. It rolls through the Auger's rooms but never takes root. It entered my front door and exited the back without paying. One cowrie.
results.1ct4ptw: One step off the Auger's staircase. Stand on it, and it rises on its own. Three cowries, ascending.
results.0yvmuzm: The central post of the Auger. It climbed itself! Everything leans against it, including me. Five cowries, and it leans back.

results.0sv8b0u: Moon snail. It drills a round hole in anything and enters. It drilled my cowries, the little button. Six cowries. Three, with a hole in.
results.0asfs7j: The swell that raised the Auger at high tide and set them down again lifts cargo, and prices too. Three cowries this morning. Four now.
results.0zgzj7x: Gran's cast. It appeared in my bundle, resting atop the cowries. No price. I carried her. I never purchased her, and I would not sell her.
results.0awgoyb: Kelp from the Low Line. It stands tall when the tide recedes. It lies down out of politeness when you sit nearby. Manners cost two cowries.
results.010pzdz: A patch of sea meadow with a face in it! Step on it, and it flattens, slowing your stride. Two cowries. Retrieve your foot before supper.
results.0c46kzl: From a lightless depth, with both eyes atop its head. It stares at the sky constantly. Three cowries. It refuses to look at money.
results.1qyql87: It claims to have fallen from the sky. It has repeated this story at every market for six years. Two cowries, regardless of what it says.
results.02ycnty: One arm from a nautilus. It let go and kept reaching, yet has found nothing to hold. Three cowries. It has been reaching for my purse.
results.0qqpemg: Plus the jet a nautilus expels. It breathes other things away from it, mostly toward my stall. Two cowries. Pay from over there.
results.04dbhbm: The night a star crossed the moon, preserved and replayed. Twice, if you watch. Four cowries for both showings.
results.1s6s35d: Stones the Nautilus folk carried to sink a room. They sink on their own now. Three cowries. Weigh it before you pay, and after.
results.0s45zx4: A gate between two Nautilus rooms. It lets one side through but never specifies which. Three cowries, or the other side of three.
results.0obxyps: Air from a sealed room, kept so long it grew a shell. It smells of the year the room was shut. Good year. Two cowries.
results.16g37pi: A bird circled the beach, never landing. Only its shell fell. Seven cowries. It's still circling if you care.
results.1j57ejw: The Nautilus's first chamber, pea-sized. It grew its own shell and keeps expanding. Six cowries today. Larger tomorrow.
results.0vc6k54: The pause between tides, trapped in a shell. Silence reigns. I sold one once. The buyer remains. Four cowries.
results.0xcqa4s: A frozen brine finger reached the sea floor. Points down. Always correct. Hand over three cowries, mittens on.
results.09uiq55: An interior wall of the Nautilus. Seals off whatever passes, so I take the long route around it. Three cowries. Do not lead.
results.1l5t0nc: Salt stains forming rings where a puddle evaporated. Steals a ring from anyone standing inside. Three cowries, minus a ring.
results.1vlf0m3: The shell a nautilus seals shut. It closes any door it touches. Mine hasn't budged since! I'm writing this through the glass. Four cowries.
results.1jcf3d2: A star that descended brightly to a low spring and refused to go out. Don't put it in your pocket! Four cowries, plus a new pocket.
results.1cexk69: Dune grass. Its roots keep the Long Strand intact, but one root walked away, and this is it. Two cowries. The Strand wants it back.
results.04zauqt: A brittle salt plant from the base of a label post. It spits, and salt accumulates on whatever it hits. Two cowries per pinch.
results.0d5cbuc: The blinding white glare of a salt flat at night. Stare at it, and everything else fades, including the price. Three cowries.
results.1y6llgx: A jellyfish left behind by the receding spring. It ripples when anyone speaks nearby, so I'm writing this entry very quietly. Three cowries.
results.06tt1qb: An empty slot in the Tray, still waiting for its shell. It's square and expectant. It expects at least four cowries from you.
results.1o698t4: A hollow salt crystal, stepped into like a staircase. Every step leads deeper, and none lead out. Three cowries go in. None come out.
results.0ey7y4e: A crab, crusted white with salt. It walks between the slots but never into one. It's sideways about the price, too. Three cowries.
results.1hccnfw: It took one of everything from the Tray and keeps them all under its wings. It took one of my cowries, too. Four cowries, so five, really.
results.008o8je: Gleaner's footprint, house-long. Stars land in it willingly. Three cowries per footprint. The foot isn't mine to sell.
results.0mnwdpv: Cuttlefish bone. Mirrors its neighbor. Matched my counter a week prior. Three cowries. It's on the counter. Somewhere.
results.1c8qh2o: White post in a Tray slot. Stands only where placed. Four cowries, so choose its spot wisely.
results.1m8t8h2: Label post. Walks to the nearest shell, stands before it. Before me since Tuesday. Three cowries. Hasn't written yet.
results.1g2q3wg: Top shell from a Tray world. Spins unseen, so I sell it blind. Three cowries. Count change by touch.
results.03ngx1w: A shore bird that skims the edge of every wave. It has never been wet in its life. Two cowries, dry.
results.0yqnkch: The crest of a high tide that breached the Conch and refused to leave. It drenches whatever sits lowest. Three cowries for a puddle.
results.0hkwq70: A pink pearl that rolls toward voices. Speak its price, and it rolls to you. Four cowries! See? It's coming.
results.1146zbf: The spiral inside the Conch that amplifies sound as it passes through. Four cowries. I sneezed near it once and lost a window.
results.1mgfe7u: A ring within a ring. It keeps whatever rests in it level. It kept my tea steady through an entire storm. Four cowries. The storm was free.
results.0gqokmz: The silence in the Conch's mouth while the great one sleeps. A specific kind of quiet. Four cowries. Shh.
results.0agovad: The flared rim of the Conch. It widens when it hears its name, so I call it Plim in my shop. Four cowries, Plim.
results.057f8vd: One of seven stars that fell as one. It searches for the other six, finding one occasionally. Four cowries. The full set costs more.
results.11asujy: A star that traveled as far as it could and is now returning. It moves faster as it approaches. Five cowries, and stand aside.
results.022xoe8: The Tide-reader's grandmother's brass star-measurer. It kept measuring after she died. Six cowries. It measured me. I'm short.
results.05ycdjq: Mudlark's hole. Traps finds and people. I fell in, lost an afternoon. Cost: Three cowries.
results.0febdcq: Stalked eye from a conch. Silent for three years. I always blink first. Cost: Three cowries.
results.0ks9w3j: Conch's inner roar. You hear the shell, not the sea. Backward sound. Cost: Three cowries either way.
results.1n13ia5: Salt bloom on the lip. Preserves all it touches. My hands remain dry. Cost: Three cowries.
results.0zxryez: Hand-shaped coral. It grips tight. Pay three cowries if it releases you in time.
results.0euc2n4: Salty, crisp plant. Pickles what it holds. Let go fast to keep your cowries.
results.1tqjd7w: A pink bloom from the saltiest pool on the Strand. The water it rests in matches the Conch's lip. Six cowries. Pink if you possess them.
results.0dv37ru: The oldest whorl in the Gleaner's Tray. Its origin is unknown. It demands your finest possession. Seven cowries, plus your best thing.
results.0ou5u7w: A coiled shell from a vanished beach. It won't budge until struck. Then it yields its secret. I'd pay the six cowries without hesitation.
results.03alop9: The Gleaner, seated. Priceless. I do not know who to pay.
results.1jwuy2l: A twelve-stone collar, once worn by a forgotten neck. It sets its own gems now, in a private order. Priceless. It keeps taking my cowries.
